{{ModBox}}
'''Thermite Rounds''' is a [[mod]] that increases both the {{D|Heat}} damage and [[status chance]] of a rifle by 15% per rank for a maximum of 60% at Rank 3.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! {{D|Heat}} Damage
! [[Status chance]]
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || +15% || +15% || 4
|-
| 1 || +30% || +30% || 5
|-
| 2 || +45% || +45% || 6
|-
| 3 || +60% || +60% || 7
|}

==Acquisition==
*Thermite Rounds can be acquired as a random end-of-mission reward for a successful high-level [[Spy]] mission with all 3 Data Vaults hacked.
{{MissionTable|Rosalind|Nereid|Kelpie|Oceanum|Pago}}
{{DropLocations}}
*This mod is also made available from [[Baro Ki'Teer]] for {{cc|150,000}} + ‍{{dc|300}} in the Concourse section of the [[Relay|Tenno Relay]]. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this mod may not be available on a succeeding appearance.
==Notes==
*'''Thermite Rounds''' is additive with similar mods. For example, a {{Weapon|Braton Prime}} with a max rank '''Thermite Rounds''' and {{M|Rifle Aptitude}} will have a {{Math|26% {{mul}} (1 + 60% + 90%)|t = y|p = y}} [[status chance]].

==Trivia==
*Originally this mod was acquired by scoring at least 17 points in a single [[Operation: Breeding Grounds]] node run.
*Unlike the previous [[The Cicero Crisis|Cicero]] and [[Tethra's Doom|Tethra]] mod sets that depict Warframes already available at the time of the event, the cards from [[Operation: Breeding Grounds]] depicted  {{WF|Mirage}}, a Warframe that at the time was yet to be revealed or released.
*[[wikipedia:Thermite|Thermite]] is a pyrotechnic composition of metal powder and metal oxide. The intense heat it generates when ignited is used to cut through or weld together metal objects for civil or military purposes, such as welding together copper wires for electrical connections.

{{Codex|Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. This is Octavia's signature rifle.}}
The '''Tenora''' is {{WF|Octavia}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] assault rifle, which features two different firing modes: a standard full-auto fire mode that increases fire rate and accuracy the longer it shoots, and an [[Alternate Fire]] mode that fires a single powerful, charged shot. Has a chance to instantly refill magazine after a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] charged shot kill while being used by Octavia.

This weapon can be sold for {{Cc|7,500}}.

==Characteristics==

* This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage.
* Primary fire requires a spool-up of '''9''' shots before optimal fire rate is achieved.
** Fire rate starts at '''40%''' of the listed value, and increases by '''7.5%''' per shot.
** '''40''' shots are required before optimal accuracy is achieved.
* Alternative fire charges a single powerful shot with perfect accuracy.
** Innate 1 meter [[Punch Through]].
** Uses 10 ammo per shot.
** Charge is automatic and does not need to be held down.
*Increased [[accuracy]] the longer the weapon is fired.

{{Advantages|name=Tenora|class=Rifle|trigger=Auto-Spool|
* Innate punch through helps bypasses thin obstacles and bodies.
}}

{{Disadvantages|name=Tenora|class=Rifle|trigger=Auto-Spool|
* Spool-up creates a warm-up period of weakness for fire rate, making short engagements undesirable.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Tenora Prime}}

==Acquisition==
The Tenora's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Tenno Lab|Tenno Lab]] in the [[dojo]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*As a [[Signature Weapon]], Tenora gains a bonus effect with {{WF|Octavia}} or {{WF|Octavia Prime}}, where [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] kills with the [[Alternate Fire]] have a '''20%''' chance to instantly refill magazine.
**The refilled ammo is automatically deducted from ammo reserves, and does '''not''' generate ammo.
**No weak spots other than actual heads will trigger this effect.
*Tenora's charge shot deals 24 damage for every 1 ammo consumed (a total of 240 damage with max consumption of 10 ammo) per shot. This is of equal ammo efficiency to its primary fire.
*{{M|Heavy Caliber}}'s accuracy penalty will be very apparent even at full spool.

==Trivia==
*''Tenora'' is the [[wikipedia:Catalan language|Catalan]] word for ''[[wikipedia:Tenor|Tenor]]'', one of the highest classical male singing voices.
**Tenora may also be a reference to a type of [[wikipedia:Catalan shawm|Catalan Shawm]], an oboe-like woodwind instrument typically used in [[wikipedia:Catalonia|Catalonia]].
*While there are other weapons with spool-up time, like the {{Weapon|Soma}} and {{Weapon|Gorgon}} series, its accuracy being increased the longer the trigger is held is currently unique to the Tenora in the primary category and shared only with {{Weapon|Aksomati Prime}}.

==Bugs==
*Spent ammo cartridges will always use the default color scheme of the weapon.
*Riven mods that increase recoil above 55% appear to drain 11 ammo instead of 10 on charged shots.

Can now alt fire an entire clip as a large burst radius grenade launcher.}} The '''Tenet Tetra''' is the [[Tenet]] variant of the {{Weapon|Tetra}} projectile rifle, sporting drastic improvements to its damage, [[critical chance]], [[critical multiplier]], [[status chance]], and magazine size, at the cost of reduced [[fire rate]] and slightly slower [[reload speed]]. Its [[Alternate Fire]] consumes all ammo to shoot an explosive grenade that reloads slightly faster than the automatic fire. ==Characteristics== *This weapon primarily deals {{D|Puncture}} damage, and the grenade deals {{D|Blast}} damage. *Primary Fire shoots energy shots in fully automatic fashion. *Alternate Fire launches a single grenade that explode in an '''8''' meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy, dealing {{D|Blast}} damage. **Consumes all remaining ammunition. **Damage of the alt-fire scales linearly with the percentage of the remaining magazine. Damage does not scale with magazine capacity modding, rather diversifies the damage scaling **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Can benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) and {{M|Cautious Shot}}. **{{M|Heavy Caliber}}'s effect is minimal on this fire mode (note that it will still punish the primary fire mode). *Can use the Tetra-exclusive {{M|Focused Acceleration}} and {{M|Kinetic Ricochet}} mods. *Adversary Weapon: **Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, based on the Sister's [[Adversary System/Progenitor|progenitor Warframe]], which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%. ***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%). **[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity. **{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely. **Listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement is not enforced - the weapon may theoretically be obtained at any mastery rank by acquiring and vanquishing a Sister that has this weapon equipped. {{Advantages| }} {{Disadvantages| *Alternate Fire: **Consumes all remaining ammunition. **Projectile has heavy arcing. **Cannot be manually reloaded to bypass reload delay. **The {{M|Kinetic Ricochet}} mod does not affect the alt-fire projectile. **Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. **Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. **Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 40% from central impact. *Projectiles have travel time. }} {{WeaponComparison|Tetra}} {{WeaponComparison|Prisma Tetra}} ==Acquisition== {{Transclude|Adversary System/Weapons#Tenet Acquisition (Sister)}} ==Notes== {{Transclude|Adversary System#Notes}} {{Transclude|Adversary System/Progenitor}} ==Tips== *Equipping a [[Riven Mods|Riven]] with reduced magazine capacity can benefit the Tenet Tetra's alt-fire grenade mode, as it means a greater overall number of explosive shots that can be unloaded from the gun's total ammunition. ==Trivia== *Fourth lowest [[fire rate]] of all fully automatic rifles, after {{Weapon|Panthera}}, {{Weapon|Panthera Prime}}, and {{Weapon|Trumna}}. ==Media== Tenet Tetra (1).png| Tenet Tetra when shown in the arsenal Tenet Tetra (2).png| Tenet Tetra (3).png| {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|jcN9bBWgZ7Y|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|33}} *Fixed Tenet Tetra Secondary fire being unaffected by Void Fissure buff. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''We also increased the alt fire ammo requirement per projectile: '''Tenet Tetra:''' *Alt fire is no longer a toggle, and doesn't require a full mag to fire. *Total damage is now based on ammo in mag on fire. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 40 Ammo per Pick Up: *Tenet Tetra ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. {{ver|30.8}} *Fixed the Tenet Tetra semi-auto mode breaking if a -magazine capacity Riven is equipped. As reported here: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1280237-tenet-tetra-mag-cap-riven-disables-semi-fire/ {{ver|30.5.4}} *Added 60% fall off to the Tenet Tetra Alt Fire area-of-effect as intended. {{ver|30.5}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Tetra}}, the normal variant. *{{Weapon|Prisma Tetra}}, the [[Prisma]] variant. *{{Weapon|Stahlta}}, another Corpus weapon that is somewhat functionally similar. *{{Weapon|Aeolak}}, the gun wielded by a [[Thrax Legatus]] that is somewhat functionally similar. {{WeaponNav}} [[es:Tetra tenet]] [[uk:Тетра-догмат]]

{{Codex|Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.}}
The '''Tenet Plinx''' is the [[Tenet]] variant of the {{Weapon|Plinx}}. In addition to improvements to its damage, [[critical chance]], and [[status chance]], it has gained an [[Alternate Fire]] that consumes the entire magazine to fire a projectile that pulls in enemies and explodes, dealing {{D|Radiation}} damage at the cost of longer recharge delay.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage and has innate {{D|Heat}} damage on its primary fire, and {{D|Radiation}} damage on its [[Alternate Fire]].
*Alternate Fire charges up a shot in '''0.8''' seconds to discharge an explosive that embeds, {{D|Knockdown|knocks down}} and pulls in enemies within '''6''' meters before exploding after '''0.8''' seconds, dealing damage and {{D|Ragdoll|Ragdolling}} enemies.
**Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
**Alternate Fire only consumes a '''full''' magazine, resulting in a 1-round magazine and must fully recharge for every shot.
**Damage is multiplied by magazine size. Damage bonus is multiplicative to other damage buffs.
**Reload delay of '''2 '''seconds after using the alternate fire.
**Alternate fire does not benefit from {{M|Synth Charge}}.
*Does not use ammo pickups; ammo regenerates over time.
**Has a '''0.8''' second delay after the weapon stops firing before regenerating ammo. Then, regenerates '''20''' ammo per second; takes '''0.5''' seconds to regenerate a fully depleted battery excluding the delay.
*Adversary Weapon:
**Comes with an additional bonus {{D|Impact}}, {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Cold}}, {{D|Electricity}}, {{D|Toxin}}, {{D|Magnetic}}, or {{D|Radiation}} damage, based on the Sister's [[Adversary System/Progenitor|progenitor Warframe]], which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
***[[Valence Fusion]] can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
**[[Polarization|Polarizing]] the weapon increases its max [[rank]] by '''2''', capping at rank '''40''' after '''5''' polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
**{{Resource|Elemental Vice}} can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
**Listed [[Mastery Rank]] requirement is not enforced - the weapon may theoretically be obtained at any mastery rank by acquiring and vanquishing a Sister that has this weapon equipped.

{{Advantages|
}}

{{Disadvantages|*Alternate Fire:
**Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]].
**Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.
**Explosion has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 60% from central impact.
}}
{{WeaponComparison|Plinx}}

==Acquisition==
{{Transclude|Adversary System/Weapons#Tenet Acquisition (Sister)}}

==Notes==

*The pull (but not the ragdoll from the explosion) effect works with Trinity's Well of life-affected enemies.
*Alt-fire will only fire if the magazine is full. Attempting to alt fire with partially full magazine will result in nothing happening.
**Despite the damage values listed on the arsenal, the attack deals 100 {{D|Impact}} on contact and 100 {{D|Radiation}} on explosion, multiplied by the magazine capacity. This results in 10x and 2x higher damage than what is respectively listed at base.
**Despite the status chance value listed on the arsenal, the alt-fire AoE has '''50%''' status chance, not 20%.
**Alt-fire AoE has an unlisted embedded delay of 0.8 seconds.
***The explosion may trigger early if the slug itself kills the target, especially on headshots. Sometimes, only one of its [[multishot]] slugs will skip the delay, while all others explode on time.
**{{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}) does '''not''' affect the pull radius.
**Increasing [[Magazine Capacity]] (e.g. {{M|Slip Magazine}} ({{M|Primed Slip Magazine|Primed}}), {{M|Ice Storm}}, {{M|Tainted Clip}}, or {{M|Combo Fury}}) will increase the Alternate Fire's damage.
***Damage bonus is multiplicative to base damage bonuses such as {{M|Hornet Strike}}.

{{Transclude|Adversary System#Notes}}
{{Transclude|Adversary System/Progenitor}}

== Known Bugs ==
* {{M|Galvanized Shot}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from alt-fire.

==Trivia==
*Tenet Plinx's Alt-fire is the only weapon to currently have a unique reload time on its alternative fire mode. Spearguns previously listed separate reload times for their throwing attacks, and could even reload using these values by manually reloading while charging the throw.
